name: Skyline Smash Arena
about: Six air-conditioned badminton courts with tournament-grade lighting, plus two outdoor pickleball courts. Popular for evening doubles.

reviews.name: Riya Sharma
reviews.text: Best lighting in Dwarka, no shadows on the shuttle.

reviews.name: Arjun Mehta
reviews.text: Great courts, parking gets full after 7 PM.

name: Greenfield Turf Club
address: Near District Centre, Janakpuri West, New Delhi 110058
about: Floodlit 5-a-side and 7-a-side football turf that converts to two box-cricket pitches. Night games are a local favourite.

reviews.name: Arjun Mehta
reviews.text: Turf is well maintained, ball rolls true.

reviews.name: Kabir Singh
reviews.text: Fun for box cricket with friends.

name: The Rally House
address: Lane 3, Press Enclave Road, Saket, New Delhi 110017
about: Three hard tennis courts and four pickleball courts with a small pro shop. Coaching available on weekday mornings.

reviews.name: Neha Gupta
reviews.text: Courts are resurfaced and the ball machine is a gem.

name: Hoopstreet Courts
address: Sector 8 Market Road, Rohini, New Delhi 110085
about: Two full-size outdoor basketball courts with glass backboards. Weekend 3v3 pickup games run every Saturday.

reviews.name: Ishaan Rao
reviews.text: Proper rims, proper crowd. Love it.

reviews.name: Arjun Mehta
reviews.text: Good courts, gets humid in the evenings.

name: Spin Republic
address: J-Block Main Market, Rajouri Garden, New Delhi 110027
about: Eight table-tennis tables and two badminton courts in a quiet indoor hall. Great for practice sessions.

reviews.name: Kabir Singh
reviews.text: Tables are excellent, AC could be stronger.

name: Boundary Box Cricket
address: Rooftop, Ambience Lane, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi 110070
about: Rooftop box-cricket arena with bowling machine and live scoreboard. Opens 3 PM onwards, ideal for after-college games.

reviews.name: Kabir Singh
reviews.text: Rooftop vibe at night is unbeatable.

reviews.name: Arjun Mehta
reviews.text: Bowling machine is great for practice.

name: AquaLane Sports Centre
address: Aurobindo Marg, near Green Park Metro, New Delhi 110016
about: A 25-metre temperature-controlled pool with lane bookings, plus three indoor badminton courts.

reviews.name: Neha Gupta
reviews.text: Water is clean and the lanes are not crowded in the mornings.

reviews.name: Riya Sharma
reviews.text: Nice place to cool down after badminton.

name: Kickoff Rooftop Turf
address: Pusa Road, Karol Bagh, New Delhi 110005
about: Compact rooftop 5-a-side turf with a city-skyline view. Evening slots fill fast on weekends.

reviews.name: Arjun Mehta
reviews.text: Small but super fun, great for quick games.
